issues.where: crop 4, thin scalloped margin and tip of the broad backlit leaf on the right
issues.what: The blade stays dark and opaque right up to the pale frost rim. The thin lobes do not pick up the light behind them, so the blade reads like a cutout.
issues.fix: Let light pass through the thin lobes and tip while keeping the thicker veins and the frost visually distinct.

issues.where: crops 1 and 5, lower bud bracts and right-hand leaf edges
issues.what: Frost follows several overlapping edges as a nearly continuous white outline, with little change in how far it spreads onto the surface. It looks like an edge treatment rather than a deposit.
issues.fix: Break the rim into sparse and dense clusters, vary crystal size, and carry some deposits onto exposed faces and hairs while leaving sheltered edges bare.

issues.where: crop 8, silhouetted heads across the skyline
issues.what: Several distant heads resolve to the same shallow, spiked cup silhouette even through the blur, making the stand look instanced.
issues.fix: Vary bract profiles, head tilt, and growth stage among the plants that break the skyline.
